text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - Elevated 5xx errors from EU inference fleet (eu-west-1). Alerting: 502 spikes + client timeouts ~15% error rate for hosted text-generation API. Auto-pager triggered. Warroom: https://zoom.example.com/j/8812345678 (ops-bridge). Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/ops/p1-inference. Initial hypothesis: recent rollout of model v2.3.5 -> start with canary rollback and capacity check.

lindsey: Ack. I'm oncall and joining warroom. Will own initial coordination.

marc: On it — starting canary rollback for routing group A (20% traffic). Pushing rollback to model v2.3.4 now.

priyanka: Checking autoscaler and GPU pool. Noting queue depth on serving-ks-*-eu is high, some nodes in 'evicting' state. Might be KV cache pressure.

emma: Comms lead volunteer. Drafting status page + customer note, will post when we agree on scope.

zane: Support triage: customers reporting timeouts: corp-acme, stripe-integ, beta-corp. I'm pulling customer logs and usage spikes.

oliver: Product: please include precise window + mitigation steps in the customer note. Use short actionable language.

marc: Rollback initiated: routing changes pushed. Confirmed 3/5 canary workers reverted. Monitoring.

marc: quick logs (tail from worker-3):
```
2026-03-17T10:12:02Z worker-3 ERROR serve: accept loop: write tcp 10.0.2.3:443: write: connection reset by peer
2026-03-17T10:12:03Z worker-3 WARN memory: kvcache miss ratio rising 0.72
2026-03-17T10:12:04Z worker-3 ERROR runtime: allocation failed: out of memory
```

lindsey: Thanks — marc, you own mitigation. priyanka, infra support for scaling and cache. emma handle external comms + status page. scribe-bot will keep timeline.

priyanka: I've temporarily increased fallback pool (gpu-fallback-eu) + bumped max pods from 40->60. Also toggled cache TTLs to reduce memory pressure. Monitoring metrics: https://grafana.redwood/d/serving/eu-west-1?panelId=23

emma: Status page draft (please quick approve):
"We are investigating elevated error rates affecting text-generation in eu-west-1. Users may see 502/timeout errors. Our engineers are rolling back a recent model deployment and increasing capacity. Next update in 15 minutes or earlier."
Please :thumbsup: if OK.

oliver: :thumbsup: short and clear. Add link to support contact for affected customers.

zane: prepping customer outbound for corp-acme: draft below — ping me edits.
"We are investigating intermittent 502 errors for inference requests from eu-west-1. Our engineers have initiated a rollback and increased capacity. If you continue to experience issues, please reply and include request IDs."

lindsey: Confirming pager delivery: @marc acknowledged, @priyanka acknowledged, @emma acknowledged. Incident owner: marc. Comms lead: emma. Secondary owner infra: priyanka.

scribe-bot: Timeline note: 10:12 UTC - alert received; 10:14 UTC - rollback started; 10:17 UTC - fallback pool scaled; 10:20 UTC - partial improvement observed.

marc: Seeing error rate drop to ~3% on canary after rollback, rolling out to remaining groups in a controlled manner.

priyanka: No new OOMs after TTL tweak + scaling. Memory pressured nodes draining and replaced. I'll keep autoscaler at +25% buffer for 30m.

emma: Posted status update: https://status.redwood/example/incident-1769504321. Will send customer note to affected accounts in 10 min window.

zane: Sent targeted message to corp-acme + beta-corp. Notifying enterprise CSMs.

lindsey: Good progress. Next check-in in 10 minutes. If error rate holds <1% for 15m, we'll declare mitigation and begin postmortem capture. :eyes:
